settings.headline: A short application,
settings.subtitle: Read the guidelines, check that your work fits a program, then send a five-question letter of inquiry through our grants portal.

settings.headline: Is your organization
settings.subtitle: If you're not sure, ask. We would rather have the conversation early.
settings.yes_list:
Nonprofits, tribes and public agencies working in the Alder River region
Community groups without nonprofit status, through a fiscal sponsor
Organizations led by the communities they serve
General operating costs as well as projects
Groups that have never had a foundation grant before
settings.no_list:
Individuals or scholarships
Work outside the Alder River region
Political campaigns or lobbying
Raising money for endowments or buildings
Debt repayment or work that is already finished

settings.headline: From first note to
settings.subtitle: Most grants take ten to twelve weeks from letter of inquiry to payment. Rapid Response decides in ten working days.

steps.title: Talk to us
steps.text: Optional, and encouraged. Book a 20-minute call or come to office hours.

steps.title: Letter of inquiry
steps.text: Five questions in the grants portal: who you are, what you do, what you need and why now.

steps.title: Conversation
steps.text: If your work fits, a program officer calls you and invites a full application.

steps.title: Full application
steps.text: About six pages, or a proposal you already wrote for another funder, plus a budget.

steps.title: Decision and payment
steps.text: The board meets every month. Payments go out within two weeks of a yes.

settings.headline: Questions
settings.subtitle: About eligibility, the application and what happens after.
